Founded in 1987, NCTV17 is Naperville's nonprofit, community-centered media hub, dedicated to keeping our community informed, connected, and engaged.

Every day, we bring Naperville to life through trusted local journalism—covering local government, schools, elections, high school sports, community events, and the people, places, and perspectives that shape our city. Our reporting is guided by accuracy, integrity, and a commitment to serving the public with information and community storytelling that is free and accessible to everyone.

Your support makes this work possible.

By donating, you're helping preserve trusted local journalism for today and for future generations of Naperville residents.

Keeping Naperville Informed. Connecting a Community.
